1.title: US appeals court halts Trump ballroom project paving way for Supreme Court showdown
1.summary: "Whether or not a ⁠massive ballroom should be constructed is for Congress to decide," the appeals panel's ​majority said.

2.title: Bill Cassidy Will Back Todd Blanche as Attorney General, Salvaging His Confirmation
2.summary: The Louisiana senator said that, despite reservations, he would back President Trump’s pick for attorney general, giving Republicans enough votes for a majority.

3.title: Appeals Court Upholds Block on Trump Ballroom Construction
3.summary: A federal appeals court panel backed a lower court’s ruling, and made it likely that the Supreme Court will decide the case. But the decision does not mean construction will halt immediately.

4.title: Spain threatens retaliation if Italy fails to lift border controls after Ceuta crossings
4.summary: Italy has said it will not accept "ultimatums or impositions" after the mass crossing of migrants from Morocco to Ceuta last week.

5.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan Sign Joint Defense Pact
5.summary: The agreement treats an attack on any of the countries as an attack on all, but in a region of volatile rivalries, it was unclear how it would work in practice.

6.title: Trump Administration Fast-Tracks Military Partnership With Colombia to Target Drug Traffickers
6.summary: The country’s new Trump-endorsed president takes office on Friday. Sweeping plans to target drug traffickers with U.S. help are already underway.
